kind: Source and format observations, synthetic unit tests and an installed-asset sweep of the Ghoul2 .glm and .gla readers
claims: format boundary only; nothing is posed, skinned or drawn; no runtime or rendering claim

mesh.structure: surface hierarchy offset table after the header, then one chained block per level of detail

vertex.layout: normal, position, one packed word, four bytes of weight

skeleton.poolSizeDecidedBy: the highest pose index; the pool need not sit at the end of the file

refuses: a surface index that is not its own position, or a back-pointer that does not reach the file header
a parent, child or bone index outside the model's surfaces or bones
a triangle corner naming a vertex the surface does not have
a vertex weighted to a bone its surface never references, or with a weight count outside one to four
a mesh referencing more bones than the skeleton it names
a forward step that does not move forward
reader.offsetRule: each offset table is read from immediately after its header; the header's stated offset must be the first record after that table; every entry must point at the record the walk reaches

installedSweep.invocation: --installation <path>; writes only below --output; keeps no retail payload

installedSweepFinding: the offset table after each header is followed by the records it points at, and the header's stated offset points at the first record, not the table; every retail model was refused until the readers matched that

syntheticChecks.mesh: two-surface, two-level mesh with parent and child reads with totals, deepest bone reference and heaviest vertex
syntheticChecks.weights: packed word round-trips; four weights decode to the values written and sum to one; single-weight vertex is entirely its bone
syntheticChecks.skeleton: three-bone, two-frame skeleton reads with scale, pose-pool depth and widest bone; one with no frames still describes its bones
syntheticChecks.malformed: wrong identifiers and versions, unterminated names, negative and oversized counts, lying offsets, indices leaving the model, triangle past the vertex list, vertex weighted to an unreferenced bone, frame past the pose pool, every truncation of both files

noRetailPayload: no retail model, animation or asset is required, incorporated or shipped
